title: Beast Games Staircase
description: A surreal cinematic scene featuring a grand spiral staircase with cracks and glowing green vines. A woman in a golden gown stands on the stairs holding a green 'BEAST' sign while a passenger airplane flies through the center with 'Beast Games YouTube Originals' text above it. Floating orbs, mythical figures, ornate golden patterns and a fleur-de-lis decorate the composition.
